steps.title: The beginning
steps.text: Enter the New Foundations portal outside King Roald's throne room in Varrock Palace.

postconditions.text: Is there no way that you will reconsider?

steps.text: After the conversation has ended, enter through the door and talk to King Roald.
[Accept Quest]
After the cutscene, talk with King Roald.

postconditions.text: The screen fades out and back in. The player has returned to the starting point outside the throne room door.

steps.title: Saving Bill the architect
steps.text:
Travel north-east from Varrock, near Jolly Boar Inn and the easternmost boundary of the Wilderness wall.
  • Fastest way to get there is by teleporting to the Infernal Source Dig Site and run slightly north-east (need level 20 Archaeology).
Click the portal to 'Continue New Foundations'.
Defeat the armoured zombies.
Talk to Bill towards the north of the well.
When the chat has ended, go southwest to the Fort Forinthry blueprints (table behind the bank chest) to build the Workshop.

steps.title: Building the Workshop
steps.text:
Check the plans with the Fort Forinthry blueprints and start building the Workshop (Tier 1) which requires:
  • 6 stone wall segments (can be made from 24 limestone bricks)
  • 8 wooden frames (can be made from 96 planks)

Build the Workshop by interacting with one of the six Construction hotspots around the edges of the Workshop area.
  • The optimal Construction hotspot moves periodically but improves the progress slightly.
Talk to Bill.

steps.title: Recruiting help
steps.text: Head to the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock and talk to Aster (outside by the tables).
Head to Gunnarsgrunn (Barbarian Village) and talk to Overseer Siv (centre of the village).
Head to Draynor Village and speak to Father Flint in the Draynor Village marketplace.
Head back to the fort and speak to Bill.

steps.title: Building the fortifications
steps.text: Proceed to build the fortifications around the fort. The order does not matter.
Find the appropriate hotspot located within the area.

steps.text:
Once all structures have been built, talk to Bill and finish the dialogue.
  • The title you choose may be changed afterwards.
Quest complete!
